summary: Validated scraper schedule auth-cookie regression across backend and frontend. Admin login sets HTTP-only cookie, signed-in Scraper Schedule and scraper integrations return 200, and anonymous schedule access remains 401.

minor.issue: 401 detail message is generic ('Sign in again to send a test email') and not schedule-specific.

action_items: Optional: tailor unauthorized detail text in shared admin auth dependency for non-email endpoints.
No functional fix required for the requested 401-cookie regression scope.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/lib/api.js correctly sets axios.defaults.withCredentials = true; this unblocks cookie-authenticated protected calls after fresh login.
backend/server.py is very large (>5000 lines), which raises regression risk around auth-protected route consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + Store>Scraper Schedule + Integrations auth checks passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: qa@prettycheap.com.au / QaTest123!. Verified public URL from frontend/.env. Did not trigger scraper run/retry actions. External eBay/provider traffic remained MOCKED/NOT EXECUTED by scope.
rca of the issue: Original failure mode was missing credentials on Axios requests (default withCredentials=false for direct Axios usage). Current build now applies global axios.defaults.withCredentials=true, and verified GET /api/scraper/schedule returns 200 after fresh browser login while anonymous request still returns 401.
